hero.tagline: I build web and mobile apps, and the backend that makes them work.
hero.tagline2: I like taking a fuzzy problem and handing back something simple to use. I work from Cape Town, with clients local and abroad.

about.paragraph1: I've been full-stack for over 5 years. I handle both sides: the interface people see and the logic that makes it work behind it.
about.paragraph2: I pick tools by the problem in front of me, not by hype. The goal is shipping something that works and keeps working.

highlights.expertiseDesc: Specialized in building scalable web applications with modern technologies and best practices.
highlights.cleanCodeDesc: Writing maintainable, well-documented code that scales.
highlights.performanceDesc: Optimizing speed and efficiency in every project.

quality.subtitle: what to expect
quality.title: How I work
quality.description: Three things you'll notice if you work with me.

cards.name: I solve the right problem
cards.description: Before writing code, I figure out what the project actually needs. A lot gets solved by cutting, not adding.

cards.name: I ship and maintain
cards.description: I don't disappear after the deploy. I fix what breaks and stick around for maintenance when it's needed.

cards.name: I say what I think
cards.description: If an idea looks bad for the project, I'll tell you. I'd rather have an honest talk than an easy yes.

steps.content: I understand your business, goals and requirements to define the right path.

steps.title: Design

steps.title: Development

steps.title: Testing & QA

steps.title: Deploy & Delivery
